news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL Mexico City pregame entertainment announced
news_mentions.description: The NFL announced that acclaimed Música Mexicana artist Majo Aguilar and Oakland-born Blaxicana singer-songwriter MXKA will perform the national anthems of Mexico and the United States prior to the 2026 NFL Mexico City Game
news_mentions.body_text: the national football league today announced that acclaimed musica mexicana artist majo aguilar and oakland born blaxicana singer songwriter mxka will perform the national anthems of mexico and the united states prior to the 2026 nfl mexico city game between the minnesota vikings and san francisco 49ers on sunday nov 22 at 7 20 p m ct 8 20 p m et at estadio banorte majo aguilar will perform the mexican national anthem and mxka will perform the u s national anthem one of the leading contemporary voices in musica mexicana majo aguilar blends mariachi with a modern artistic vision a three time latin grammy nominee for best ranchero mariachi album and a two time consecutive premio lo nuestro winner for mexican music female artist of the year she has become a leading figure in the genre s new generation her acclaimed mariachi mio project helped redefine mariachi through contemporary influences while performances at mexico city s zocalo teatro metropolitan and canelo alvarez s boxing match in riyadh have further elevated her profile with more than 533 million global streams aguilar continues to celebrate mexican culture and bring the richness of musica mexicana to audiences worldwide i feel very happy to be able to perform the mexican national anthem mexico is a beautiful country with a rich culture said majo aguilar thank you to the nfl for inviting me to be part of such a special moment and allowing me to represent my country it fills me with pride to be mexican mxka moh kah is an oakland born blaxicana singer songwriter whose music blends the storytelling and instrumentation of musica mexicana with the melodic intimacy of contemporary r b a sound she calls r b tumbados born to a mother from mexico city and a father from louisiana she creates bilingual music that reflects her black mexican and american identities her breakout single la vuelta marked a major step in her growing career with her work also earning recognition from spotify billboard kqed and remezcla she has also performed the national anthem as part of telemundo s official fifa world cup 2026 coverage and continues to expand the boundaries of contemporary latin music through her unique cross cultural perspective getting to sing the u s national anthem in mexico city with the 49ers on the field is a moment that connects so many parts of my story said mxka i was born in oakland my mom is from cdmx and as a blaxicana artist i m proud to carry both my black and mexican roots onto a stage this big i m deeply grateful to the nfl for trusting me with this moment and i can t wait to share it with fans from mexico the bay and everywhere in between on aug 31 it was announced that the warning will headline the halftime show of the 2026 nfl mexico city game the mexico city performance is one of a record seven halftime shows presented by american express staged across the 2026 international games a lineup of musical performances spanning seven countries and four continents as the league plays its most international games ever in a single season we are excited to showcase two artists in majo aguilar and mxka pregame in mexico city each who have rich and significant connections to the country said tim tubito nfl senior director event and game presentation their powerful renditions of the mexican national anthem and the u s national anthem under the lights at estadio banorte will set the stage for the nfl s return to mexico city both the mexico and u s anthems along with the full halftime show will be broadcast live in mexico on televisaunivision s channel 5 and on espn the league is committed to growing the game at every level across mexico engaging fans year round through partners programs and initiatives further information around the entertainment and fan events surrounding the 2026 nfl mexico city game will follow soon tickets for the 2026 nfl mexico city game are on sale now at nfl com mexicocity to stay up to date on all things nfl mexico and for more on the 2026 nfl mexico city game follow nflmx on instagram x and tiktok sixty two regular season nfl games have been played outside the united states with london berlin munich frankfurt madrid dublin sao paulo mexico city and toronto having hosted games to date

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys defense hopes to stay 'disciplined' vs. Lamar Jackson after struggling with mobile QBs
news_mentions.description: The Cowboys head to Brazil this week to face Lamar Jackson and the Ravens in the NFL's first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro. The revamped Dallas D understands it has its hands full attempting to slow Jackson & Co.
news_mentions.body_text: the dallas cowboys head to brazil this week to face lamar jackson and the baltimore ravens in the nfl s first ever game in rio de janeiro the revamped dallas defense understands it has its hands full attempting to slow jackson and co we all know what it is cowboys pass rusher donovan ezeiruaku said via the team s official website you guys know we know as players the type of guy he is somebody who can throw the ball but also run the ball at a very high level it s easier to say than to do but our job is to go out there and go do that s what we re tasked with jackson leads the nfl with 10 0 pass yards per attempt through two weeks the qb hasn t run a ton 11 carries for 74 yards and a touchdown but has looked more spry when he has taken off than a year ago the cowboys must key on his scrambling ability after struggling to stop qb runs in the first two weeks against jaxson dart 11 54 and jayden daniels 7 69 the cowboys have allowed the most rushing yards to quarterbacks in the nfl 126 on 19 carries 6 6 ypc that figure would have been even worse had daniels not exited last sunday s game at halftime with an elbow injury dallas must make a more concerted effort to slow jackson just being disciplined cowboys defensive tackle kenny clark said communication just understanding our rush lanes playing with extension powering offensive linemen and just restricting those gaps so you can t get through but the main thing is just staying disciplined and communicating the ravens missing zay flowers due to a hamstring injury weren t as explosive in week 2 but the combination of jackson and derrick henry will always trouble defenses despite just five carries in the second half on sunday henry has 212 rush yards and four rush tds through two games he s tied for the nfl lead in tds and only kenneth walker 290 has more rush yards slowing both jackson and henry in the same game is a monumental task for any defense it is very unique ezeiruaku said for a guy who s probably bigger than me playing running back you ve got to take out the legs that s the only way to stop a guy like that from running the ball easier said than done like it is with lamar but it ll be a really good challenge on paper it s a rough matchup for dallas defense which through two games hasn t shown significant improvement from a year ago under christian parker too many mental mistakes remain there is a lack of pass rush and the tackling is mediocre dallas enters sunday s tilt ranked 32nd in third down percent allowed 68 30th in rush yards per game allowed 173 5 29th in yards per game allowed 391 5 29th in sacks 24th in yards per play allowed 5 8 18th in points per game 24 0 and 17th in pass yards per game 218

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks to undergo surgery, miss at least six weeks
news_mentions.description: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks has experienced another bump in the road. Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core muscle injury, which will land him on IR.
news_mentions.body_text: panthers running back jonathon brooks has experienced another bump in the road brooks is expected to undergo surgery on wednesday to repair a core muscle injury which is expected to keep him out at least six weeks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported per sources the carolina ball carrier was placed on injured reserve on wednesday knocking him out for at least four games panthers coach dave canales said brooks is expected to miss six to eight weeks brooks left early in sunday s win over the atlanta falcons and did not return it s the latest blow for the 2024 second round pick who has dealt with a litany of injuries dating back to college after missing the start of his rookie season while rehabbing a torn acl brooks took just nine carries over three games before tearing the knee ligament again he missed all of 2025 brooks returned this offseason with renewed optimism that he could be the player the panthers envisioned when they selected him with a second round pick in his first two games of the 2026 season he touched the ball 11 times for 73 yards given the buoyancy the coaching staff had when discussing brooks this offseason noting he finally looked like the player they saw on his college film the latest injury is a bummer for the back it s a reminder that getting healthy and staying healthy are two different burdens the hope is that brooks can return healthy later in the season and provide some pop out of the backfield in the meantime chuba hubbard will continue to shoulder the load with veteran aj dillon as the backup the panthers are working out veteran austin ekeler aaron wilson of kprc 2 in houston reported wednesday ekeler 31 played in two games in 2025 before tearing his achilles if healthy ekeler could potentially be a pass catching option alongside bryce young

news_mentions.headline: George Kittle on 2-0 49ers' offense: It's 'a dream come true'
news_mentions.description: The San Francisco 49ers have put up 62 points in two blowout wins to open the season and Brock Purdy has yet to be sacked as Kyle Shanahan's offense is rolling.
news_mentions.body_text: venturing from san francisco to australia and back to the bay it s been a blissful two weeks to start the season for george kittle and the 49ers first was a 27 7 blowout of the rival los angeles rams in the nfl s historic australian debut next was a walloping of the miami dolphins 35 13 for kittle playing in the current 49ers offense is a complete delight i got really lucky kittle said tuesday on the rich eisen show i get to play with trent williams right we got him hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still mike evans hall of famer plays like a hall of famer still and so just when you add guys like that it s just so much fun cause i mean every time we call a play and i know mike has a chance of getting the ball i m like this is so sick brock purdy s throwing the ball to mike evans and i m blocking for him what a dream come true kittle a seven time pro bowler noted that outside of the wide receiver room highlighted by offseason signee evans the 49ers offense is mostly a collection of familiar talent and it s going glowingly thus far i think the biggest thing is that this is essentially like the same offense we ve had for quite a while now said kittle who had four receptions for 80 yards and a touchdown against the dolphins it s the same starting o line as last year it s the same quarterback the same fullback the same running back the same tight ends the wide receiver room has changed a little bit deebo samuel s been a part of it before i think mike evans would work in any offense because of how good he is with purdy off to a sensational start having yet to be sacked and leading the nfl with an 80 4 completion percentage whilst throwing five touchdowns the 49ers are indeed humming kittle stressed a game by game approach and outlook underscoring that their week 3 tilt against the arizona cardinals would be a tough one at the moment however kittle s smiling wide it s a good time to be a 49er the niners are playing well feeling good about ourselves right now he said football s fun isn t it

news_mentions.headline: Ex-Ravens RB Jamal Lewis on Derrick Henry's lack of carries in loss: 'Don't make that mistake again'
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry received just five carries in the second half of Sunday's loss to the New Orleans Saints.
news_mentions.body_text: a bruising baltimore ravens running back of the past is confused by the use or lack thereof of a charm city standout of the present in the aftermath of derrick henry getting just five carries in the second half of the ravens 24 17 loss to the new orleans saints on sunday baltimore s all time leading rusher jamal lewis was blunt in his criticism of the approach he s a workhorse lewis said on the bmore football podcast you re not going to have a workhorse like that for long so you better use him henry 32 finished the week 2 defeat with 16 carries for 68 yards and a touchdown henry had rushed for 51 yards and a 1 yard touchdown on 11 carries as baltimore held a 14 6 halftime advantage in the second half he was given just five totes and earned 17 yards and the ravens squandered a lead that was as wide as 11 points in the opening half baltimore getting away from giving henry the ball has been a curious occurrence at times dating back to john harbaugh s reign in the 2025 ravens win or go home week 18 battle against the pittsburgh steelers for instance henry had 15 carries for 112 yards in the first half but was given the ball just five times in the second half of the 26 24 loss it was confusing for many then and it remains a conundrum now if i only got the ball 10 times in the second half i was pissed off said lewis who admitted it was a much different situation when he played than for henry who lines up in the backfield with lamar jackson the most prolific rushing quarterback in nfl history lewis still remains the ravens leading rusher with 7 801 yards like henry lewis has a 2 000 yard season to his credit unlike henry lewis owns a super bowl ring if henry jackson and baltimore are to contend for a lombardi trophy lewis is of the mind that ravens first year offensive coordinator declan doyle will need to feed the rock to henry more often in two plus seasons with henry playing for the ravens baltimore is 12 3 when the two time rushing champion has 20 plus carries it s 1 0 this year after he rumbled for 144 yards on 24 carries in a 41 23 season opening win against the indianapolis colts hopefully the offensive coordinator and the head coach learn from the mistake being that it is early in the season lewis said don t make that mistake again the ravens are headed to brazil this week to take on the dallas cowboys who have given up more rushing yards this season than all but two other teams it portends to be a prime opportunity for head coach jesse minter and his staff to heed lewis advice

news_mentions.headline: Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri kicks world record field goal in Swiss Alps
news_mentions.description: Hall of Fame kicker Adam Vinatieri earned a spot in the Guinness World Record book with his latest feat.
news_mentions.body_text: adorned with four super bowl victories three pro bowls and more than 2 600 points scored adam vinatieri was basking in the warmth of a canton ohio summer day back in august just more than a month later vinatieri was bundled up back to kicking and setting a record the hall of famer who played 10 seasons with the new england patriots and 14 more for the indianapolis colts set a guinness world record on tuesday for kicking the highest field goal in the world converting from an altitude of 3 454 meters 11 332 feet above sea level in the swiss alps the 53 year old vinatieri s kick took place at jungfraujoch known as the top of europe on snow covered ground with swirling winds snow is simply part of my time with the patriots said vinatieri who converted plenty of kicks in snowy conditions during his career including in the 2001 season s afc championship game against the raiders but kicking a field goal at 3 454 meters is something completely different from anything i ve ever done you feel the altitude with every breath you take your heart rate is different your rhythm is different and no one can really tell you beforehand how it will affect the kick because no one has done this before the fact that we were able to set the record under these conditions makes me very proud vinatieri split the uprights in front of a small but joyous gathering having made his last official nfl kick on dec 1 2019 for the colts vinatieri s latest boot was official according to guiness it also came with him donning a patriots jersey as part of the patriots countdown to their nov 15 game in munich against the detroit lions

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Giants' Jaxson Dart potentially out for season after testing shows worse knee injury
news_mentions.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart could miss the rest of the season after Tuesday testing showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: jaxson dart s 2026 season is in jeopardy the new york giants starting quarterback could potentially miss the rest of the season after testing on tuesday showed his knee injury is worse than initially feared nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported schefter added dart could undergo season ending surgery right now evaluations are ongoing we haven t gotten any final decisions yet giants head coach john harbaugh said on tuesday minutes after the report broke we ve learned a lot more i wouldn t really want to share too much until decisions get made and that takes more than one person it takes everybody involved when we know what direction we re going to have to go we ll announce that but we don t have that yet so i don t want to get out over our skis on that can t really respond to every report that people make got to work on our own timeline here harbaugh was asked specifically about the report dart could miss the rest of the season i don t think i can really comment on any of that right now until we know for sure what s going to transpire he said dart suffered the injury which reportedly was initially believed to be a sprained mcl at the end of the giants first possession in their 28 6 loss to the rams on monday night jameis winston replaced dart completing 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards and an interception dart walked off the field under his own power and was taken into the locker room for further evaluation monday night which initially produced results that were encouraging enough for dart to attempt to re enter the game espn s laura rutledge reported during the broadcast harbaugh echoed the optimistic sentiment afterward telling reporters on monday that it appeared dart avoided the devastating outcome and landed in the neighborhood of an mcl sprain adding new york would know more after a tuesday mri tuesday wasn t as positive and now the giants might have to confront a reality they d hoped to avoid dart s knee injury marks the second instance in which he s been sidelined due to health challenges he missed two games in 2025 due to a concussion and has attracted attention for his fearless style of play which has left him susceptible to more hits than the average quarterback the hit that caused the injury on monday night however occurred with dart under duress in the pocket and had nothing to do with his scrambling aggression unfortunately the outcome is too familiar to the giants who must shift toward preparing winston as their starter for the foreseeable future winston started two games in place of dart in 2025 going 0 2 in one score losses to green bay and detroit new york felt confident enough about winston s capabilities as a veteran backup to reward the 2015 no 1 overall pick with a two year 13 million extension earlier this month locking down a trusted second option behind dart he ll have a chance to prove the giants weren t misguided in their faith when new york hosts the tennessee titans 0 2 on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Bears QB Tyson Bagent in concussion protocol; Case Keenum could start Week 3
news_mentions.description: Bears backup QB Tyson Bagent is in concussion protocol, putting his status in question for Chicago's Week 3 game against the Eagles. Veteran Case Keenum could get the start under center.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears could face a quarterback conundrum on monday night against the philadelphia eagles backup bears quarterback tyson bagent is in concussion protocol nfl network insider ian rapoport reported tuesday per sources with caleb williams dealing with a hamstring injury that coach ben johnson said monday likely puts him out this week veteran case keenum could be in the starting saddle in prime time bagent entered the game in the fourth quarter of sunday s 9 3 loss to minnesota after williams exited with the hamstring injury he completed 5 of 9 passes for 54 yards on the final play of the game vikings dallas turner slammed bagent to the turf for a sack playing on monday gives the bears an extra day to get bagent through concussion protocol before having to pull the emergency handle in keenum the 38 year old is in his second season with the bears mostly acting as an extra coach in the qb room keenum hasn t thrown a pass or started a regular season game since 2023 with the houston texans in his 11 year career he s started 66 contests only four since 2020 with a career 62 3 completion percentage 15 175 yards with 79 tds and 51 ints best known for the minneapolis miracle in 2017 keenum is a wild card at this stage can he perform like a savvy vet who understands defenses knows when to take his shots and can manage the offense or might he look like an elderly signal caller meant more for his film prowess than on field acumen if bagent doesn t clear protocol by monday night we ll find out

news_mentions.headline: Drew Brees says he reached out to Broncos about comeback prior to AFC Championship Game
news_mentions.description: Hall of Fame QB Drew Brees says he reached out to the Broncos about a potential comeback prior to last season's AFC Championship Game.
news_mentions.body_text: ahead of last week s tilt between the broncos and chiefs espn reported that the broncos reached out to drew brees prior to last season s afc championship game about a potential return the news caused a kerfuffle in denver with head coach sean payton saying last week that he d never heard of brees comeback consideration during monday s episode of the let s go podcast on siriusxm co host jim gray asked brees how close he was to actually giving it a shot to return well i d say this so my wrist and my shoulder i don t throw with my right side anymore he said i mean i could throw it 10 yards and it s with a lot of pain you know so that s definitely not gonna get the job done now my mind my body everything else feels great but my right wrist right shoulder wouldn t allow it to happen but did i think about it absolutely 1 000 percent i would ve loved to come back and play for the broncos in the afc championship game get my coach and a bunch of the other guys that i know in that organization the penner family to the super bowl would ve loved it the physical inability was one reason brees couldn t make a comeback the other is that he remains on the new orleans saints reserve retired list brees said it was during his pro football hall of fame door knock that he truly thought about the possibility of returning the hof qb noted that he initiated a text to then broncos assistants pete carmichael and joe lombardi here s the story so i get the knock from the hall of fame i get the knock literally on monday january 19 it was the day after the divisional round where the news had come out that bo nix had hurt his foot he was gonna be out brees said so jim porter who s the president of the hall of fame we re there we re having this moment dan fouts is telling me i m in the hall of fame and i look at jim porter and said well i guess this means i can t go back and play for the broncos this week and he goes actually you can do whatever you want he said voting s already been done you re in you can do whatever you want and so i m telling you when i say i like flipped the switch i flipped the switch immediately texted pete carmichael and joe lombardi my oc and quarterback coach with the saints they were with the broncos i said you guys need me this week i said i might be able to be ready and they re like are you serious we ll go down and tell sean right now i said wait let me get up tomorrow let me give this thing a go so i got up the next morning and i gave it a go i had my 13 year old son catching balls for me in the backyard and man it just was not happening with the right side left side inside the 20 i would have been lethal at least could have gotten them in and out of the right plays but no it wasn t going to happen added brees that was the end of it yeah texted them back and said ah look i ll be there for moral support the moral support went for naught on that day the broncos started backup jarrett stidham in nix s stead and lost 10 7 to the patriots in rough weather conditions

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Glenn defends late-game decisions made in Jets' loss to Packers
news_mentions.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn is standing by decisions he made late in his team's Week 2 loss to the Packers.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york jets undoubtedly played better in their first two games of the 2026 season than they did in aaron glenn s first campaign as head coach however some questionable decisions by glenn in the week 2 collapse against the green bay packers linger glenn s first surprising choice came late in the fourth quarter of a tied game when he declined to call a timeout to give his offense one last shot with the ball before overtime on monday glenn doubled down on defending the decision when we have the punter at the logo we don t want to put ourselves in a situation where we get our guys in a backed up situation glenn said via the new york daily news i know we are talking about getting our offense going in that situation but the thing is they also had two timeouts i just felt like it was the right decision to do at that point and we actually wanted to play for overtime when it came to that perhaps nothing would have come of a last possession in regulation but i believe glenn missed an opportunity to see if something could pop that would tilt the game in the jets favor crazier things have happened for teams with roughly a minute left and a timeout the choice to play conservative even surprised packers coach matt lafleur oh yeah i was really confused by that lafleur said after sunday s game that s why we called the timeout and tried a hail mary glenn s other debatable call came with the decision to take the ball first in overtime with the rules allowing for both teams to possess the ball clubs have become more likely to want the ball second glenn said after the loss that he wanted the ball to control the clock during the 10 minute overtime instead a series of miscues pushed the jets back and into a quick three and out from there the packers had a relatively easy drive to win the game on monday glenn was asked if he regretted any of his decisions he said the game didn t come down to one or two plays there are always going to be decisions in that case glenn said i think every coach has that that s offense defense and special teams i think when the clock got to 11 seconds i could have easily called a timeout there and forced a punt we actually ended up getting a sack on the play so there are other plays in that game that determined the outcome of that game the reality for glenn is that in his position coaching under the microscope in new york and coming off a horrific first season his decisions will be picked apart after a loss especially after a 10 point fourth quarter lead was withered away

news_mentions.headline: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams dominate Giants in Rams' blowout win
news_mentions.description: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford tossed four touchdown passes, including two to receiver Davante Adams, in Los Angeles' blowout Monday night win over the Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron donald returned to the field on monday night and so did the los angeles rams offense which was absent in week 1 the two felt intertwined in the 28 6 blowout victory over the new york giants at sofi stadium monday marked donald s first game back since he retired after the 2023 season i was so juiced he came running out of the tunnel and i couldn t control myself matthew stafford said of donald s return i was freaking fired up i m sure y all were in there the fans were happy to see him back and we all were too just the human being the player all of it combined what he brings to our team and to our locker room is unmatched and really to the city which i thought was amazing i thought it was a great reception for him tonight well deserved the juiced stafford went out and ripped apart the banged up giants secondary whipping four touchdowns on 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards new york pressured stafford on just 15 2 of his dropbacks the fourth lowest rate he has faced in a game as a ram since 2021 per next gen stats when kept clean he completed 20 of 27 attempts for 302 yards including all four touchdowns and his lone interception which was a heat check deep shot in the second quarter despite not having all pro receiver puka nacua stafford moved the ball at will feeding davante adams the reigning mvp hit adams with 8 passes for 195 yards and two tds the rest of the rams offense combined for 132 receiving yards he s wide receiver one to me he ain t a two head coach sean mcvay said of adams he was special and it showed all night that s what he s consistently done and i m really happy for him i thought he made some great plays but you could see there s a lot of trust that he and matthew have they were able to get a lot of work together this offseason and it s only going to continue to build i was really happy for him he did his thing tonight according to opta stats the most yards by a qb receiver duo 33 or older in a game in nfl history is 289 by steve young and jerry rice on dec 18 1995 stafford and adams came in no 2 on monday with 195 a week after struggling to move the ball consistently against the 49ers in australia the rams moved unimpeded through the big blue defense gobbling up 481 yards and 23 first downs they converted 5 of 9 third downs and went 3 of 3 in the red zone outside of two turnovers in the second quarter l a did whatever it wanted with donald returning the rams d played with a little more fire and rattled backup quarterback jameis winston who was thrust into action after jaxson dart s first drive injury playing a more physical brand of defense than a week ago l a gave up just 182 total yards 11 first downs and two field goals donald noted that the speed of the game didn t feel like too much after two years off the game really wasn t as fast as i thought he said it was more of me calming myself down overrunning stuff or just my feet not being in the ground how they supposed to be not trusting my eyes little stuff like that but playing the game when i held out in 17 18 it was the same way when i came back it took a couple games to get going it s a little different i ain t played in two years so i gotta watch the film see what i did good see what i did wrong and just clean it up in his return donald had three tackles including one for loss and one quarterback pressure on 18 pass rushes tied for his career low per next gen stats after last week s dismal performance against san francisco the rams got back on track at home mcvay even took a shot at himself for the australia travel plans which were roundly panned after the blowout loss sometimes you win sometimes you learn he said sometimes you have a dumbass coach that makes travel plans that put you in a bad spot so there you go that s a dropped mic

news_mentions.headline: Giants-Rams on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Los Angeles' 28-6 win
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams cruised to their first win of the season in prime time against the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: home sweet home for rams basking in the comfortable confines of sofi stadium the rams returned home from a wayward australian adventure and returned to the form so many thought would be seen matthew stafford looked like the mvp from a season ago davante adams looked like the game tilting wide receiver he was for years and the los angeles defense with aaron donald at the center of it all was sterling as the giants sputtered with jaxson dart lost to a knee injury the rams overcame a couple of turnovers and won handily more than a week removed from falling flat in their opener in the outback against the 49ers the rams handled their business and were impressive stafford rebounding from a zero touchdown week 1 proved that was an aberration with 327 passing yards and four touchdown passes that he did so without an injured puka nacua was all the more impressive adams was simply wonderful in the no 1 wr role hauling in a pair of touchdowns and nearly 200 yards while the two headed running game of kyren williams and blake corum also got the job done 164 combined rushing yards in a game that felt like a blowout despite the rams leading by only two scores throughout most of the night l a racked up 481 yards it wasn t perfect there were turnovers and too many missed opportunities but the rams got right on monday happy to be home feeling looking and playing like themselves monday nightmare for giants seven snaps into the game jaxson dart was savagely sandwiched by the rams pass rush and left grasping his left knee that was it for dart on monday before he was ruled out though dart was joined as being questionable to return by wide receiver malik nabers fortunately nabers returned to play after dinging up his shoulder dart never got back in and andrew thomas groin and brian burns ankle were injured late in the game it was a nightmare of an evening for the giants it was reported dart tried to return to action and general manager joe schoen said he d be ok eschewing long term concerns for the time being meanwhile the giants offense was a struggle bus with jameis winston at the helm the running game went nowhere either cam skattebo was the team s leading rusher with just 36 yards on 12 carries and was curiously replaced by najee harris for two runs inside the 10 yard line late in the first half the biggest takeaway in this one is that the giants offense is absolutely lost without dart and considering his injury history that puts new york in a precarious spot donald makes long awaited return it had been 981 days since aaron donald last played a game a wild card playoff loss against the detroit lions he made a much ado return monday highlighted by stopping najee harris on a third down tackle for loss in the second quarter donald contributed three tackles perhaps more importantly as head coach sean mcvay said after halftime he was energizing the rams defense and los angeles was outstanding jaxson dart and jameis winston were constantly harassed each facing 58 plus pressure rates and new york s running game went nowhere held to 52 yards once upon a time before myles garrett was acquired via trade and donald unretired the rams trading with the chiefs for trent mcduffie was their big offseason splash mcduffie was excellent recording his first interception with his new team and piling up four pass breakups allowing no catches on five targets this was a banner homecoming for donald and a suffocating performance from the d davante s still got it puka nacua was inactive with a hip injury and the rams lack of receiving depth was exposed fortunately davante adams let everyone know he s still got plenty left in the tank piling up eight receptions on 10 targets for 195 yards and two touchdowns the catches and yards were tops for his time with the rams but underscored that the 33 year old can still take over a game if need be and l a needed him second year tight end terrance ferguson shrugged off some bad drops and finished with six catches for 54 yards and a td but his contributions largely came after the game had long been settled beyond that nobody else had more than two catches adams was a force even with stafford dialed in him when adams hauled in an 11 yard fade for six in the third quarter it wasn t just vintage adams but it looked like a called shot an inevitable six points that everyone could see coming and simply couldn t be stopped big blues on both sides on the scoreboard it looked like the giants defense was keeping them in the game more so it was a matthew stafford interception and a kyren williams lost fumble on consecutive offensive plays in the second quarter that did the trick sure the nyg d played its part in those but rams mistakes let the giants hang around in the first half new york mustered just two qb pressures of stafford but somehow only trailed 14 3 with jaxson dart injuring his knee the giants collectively seemed to take a punch to the gut all their wind gone as the game felt like a one sided affair no matter how close the score was l a totaled 481 net yards on 60 plays 8 01 yards per play stafford was pressured on just 15 2 of his dropbacks by game s end a week after a sunday night win over the rival cowboys made the giants the talk of the town they re leaving the west coast battered bruised and beaten in lopsided fashion they ll need to mend up and shore up some issues on both sides of the ball next gen stats insight for giants rams via nfl pro giants rookie right guard francis mauigoa held aaron donald to zero qb pressures on 11 matchups donald had one total qb pressure three tackles and a run stuff on 32 snaps in his first game since the 2023 season nfl research davante adams 11 yard touchdown catch was the 95th of his career including playoffs of 20 yards or fewer which tied antonio gates for second all time only jerry rice 112 has more

news_mentions.headline: Rams QB Matthew Stafford moves into sixth all time in touchdown passes
news_mentions.description: Matthew Stafford’s Hall of Fame résumé continues to build and build. Stafford’s latest accomplishment came on Monday when the Los Angeles Rams quarterback threw three touchdowns to move into sixth place all time in NFL history.
news_mentions.body_text: matthew stafford s resume for hall of fame enshrinement continues to build and build stafford s latest accomplishment came monday when the los angeles rams quarterback threw four touchdowns in a 28 6 win over the new york giants with the third score moving him into sixth place all time in nfl history davante adams caught stafford s 426th career touchdown pass an 11 yarder in the third quarter to propel stafford past philip rivers 425 he had 427 by the end of the evening it s a humbling feeling stafford told espn s lisa salters after the game aside from being a historic night for stafford it was also a massive rebound performance after he went without a touchdown toss in the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers stafford who led the nfl with 46 touchdown passes last season didn t go a game without a td throw in 2025 now he s bounced back from his atypical showing in fine fashion the 38 year old very much resides in rarefied air the reigning ap nfl mvp has fewer touchdowns than only tom brady first 649 touchdown passes drew brees second 571 peyton manning third 539 aaron rodgers fourth 528 and brett favre fifth 508 i have so much respect for the people that played this game before me and am such a big fan of those guys stafford told salters so just to be in that same breath as those guys is a cool feeling for me stafford s first two td passes monday were to adams and kyren williams with the 10 yarder to williams standing as his 143rd with the rams that put him into second all time in rams history moving him ahead of jim everett 142 stafford in six years with the rams now trails only roman gabriel 154 for most td passes in club chronicle he added his fourth touchdown throw of the game and 145th overall for l a late to tight end terrance ferguson if stafford is to catch favre and or become just the sixth nfl player to reach 500 td passes that would mean playing beyond the 2026 campaign for now however stafford has climbed another rung up the all time ladder continuing to defy father time and pen an argument for a spot in canton in the process

news_mentions.headline: Falcons vs. Packers: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 3 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can the Packers put a sloppy start behind them? Will Michael Penix Jr.'s 2026 debut spark the Falcons' offense? In advance of Thursday's game between Atlanta and Green Bay, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: thursday night s battle features two teams yearning for a spark to break out of early season doldrums the packers are playing at home for the first time in 2026 after narrowly avoiding an 0 2 start with a comeback win over the jets in overtime meanwhile the 0 2 falcons are still searching for some positive vibes after being trounced in their home opener by the panthers 34 3 green bay has a chance to make history on thursday with a win the packers will break the nfl record for consecutive victories in home openers currently tied at 13 with the 1976 1988 miami dolphins the falcons have dropped four straight at lambeau field with their last win in titletown coming back when the team s current president of football matt ryan was a rookie quarterback 2008 yes we re still early in the season but as far as week 3 games go the stakes couldn t be much higher for either club three must know storylines 1 can the packers clean it up it s been an uncharacteristically sloppy start for a team with postseason aspirations after making the playoffs in six of the past seven seasons matt lafleur s crew leads the league in penalties and penalty yards it ranks last in rushing yards also jordan love has the lowest completion rate of any quarterback with at least 30 pass attempts 52 1 the only qb over the last 10 seasons with a lower rate in his first two games of a season min 70 attempts was trevor lawrence in the first two games of his career 50 2021 per nfl research yikes obviously the packers have been playing shorthanded without edge terror micah parsons pup list and bell cow back josh jacobs commissioner s exempt list but that doesn t excuse the penalty issues green bay s not getting any better news on the injury front either after losing starting right tackle zach bako bewele torn patellar tendon for the season and wideout jayden reed to a back ailment in the win over the jets maybe the packers are catching the right opponent at the right time the falcons have their own health woes with cb1 a j terrell groin joining an ever growing list of starting defensive players on the sideline there s no way to fix everything with a short week to prepare but playing a cleaner game with love completing 60 plus percent of his throws would be a sign of progress for green bay 2 is michael penix the hero the falcons need penix is set to make his 2026 debut on thursday marking his first game back since tearing his left acl last november it s a very welcome development for a team that averaged a league low eight points and failed to reach the red zone with journeyman cooper rush starting the first two contests penix was cleared for full participation in practice about a month ago so he s had time to gear up for his return to game action it s a huge season for the eighth overall pick of the 2024 nfl draft with atlanta s new brass facing a decision on whether to exercise the fifth year option in his rookie deal next spring he compiled a record of just 4 8 as a starter in his first two seasons completing less than 60 percent of his passes and throwing for fewer than 200 yards per game thursday will give penix a chance to begin rewriting the narrative around his career and the packers are only one game removed from giving up 39 points to a vikings offense that no one is confusing for a juggernaut penix might want to avoid falling into his habit of holding on to the ball for too long though going against the team with the third highest pressure rate in the league 45 6 atlanta certainly has stockpiled an enviable collection of weapons at the skill positions with rb bijan robinson wr drake london and te kyle pitts all capable of performing at an all pro level which leads me to my next point 3 will the falcons utilize their pass catchers atlanta s wide receivers and tight ends have combined for 17 catches 173 receiving yards and zero touchdowns in 2026 all the fewest among the league s wr te units through week 2 the aforementioned pitts has only one catch for 15 yards and he s been targeted just four times that s a problem atlanta offensive coordinator tommy rees acknowledged this week telling reporters he has to do a better job of showcasing pitts who signed a contract extension this offseason that made him one of the highest paid tight ends in the league perhaps the quarterback change will help in that regard but pitts has just two touchdown catches in the 12 games penix has started penix has the arm strength to give the offense the downfield passing game it lacked in the first couple weeks now it s up to the coaching staff to exploit a packers defense that ranks 28th in red zone td percentage allowed 85 7

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 1 games: Ravens' Zay Flowers exits with hamstring injury
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 1 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 1 sunday atlanta falcons defensive lineman da 39 shawn hand knee was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the steelers offensive lineman chris lindstrom concussion was also ruled out baltimore ravens wide receiver zay flowers hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over the colts flowers had five catches for 150 yards and one touchdown before exiting nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury is not considered serious but the wr will undergo an mri cornerback t j tampa knee was ruled out in the first half rookie receiver ja 39 kobi lane suffered a fractured wrist and will miss several weeks nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolot reported chicago bears cornerback tyrique stevenson shoulder exited sunday s win over the panthers and did not return cleveland browns running back dylan sampson ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s loss to the jaguars dallas cowboys linebacker demarvion overshown suffered a hamstring injury sunday night and will undergo further testing to determined the severity head coach brian schottenheimer said safety malik hooker suffered what is likely a fractured forearm and will undergo further testing schottenheimer said detroit lions guard christian mahogany knee exited sunday s win over the saints and did not return houston texans linebacker jake hummel abdomen was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bills jacksonville jaguars defensive end bj green elbow exited sunday s win over the browns and did not return los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey chest wide receiver keandre lambert smith hamstring and cornerback elijah molden hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to the cardinals new york jets safety minkah fitzpatrick groin did not return to sunday s win over the titans wide receiver omar cooper ankle was ruled out cooper s x rays were negative but he is dealing with a sprain and will undergo an mri rapoport reported miami dolphins safety kyle louis knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray was ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s win over the packers tampa bay buccaneers cornerback jacob parrish back was ruled out of sunday s loss to the bengals washington commanders tight end chigoziem okonkwo hamstring linebacker frankie luvu groin and safety tyler owens ankle did not return to sunday s loss to the eagles

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to
