rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

subplots across the nfc west catch up on the seattle seahawks offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location virginia mason athletic center renton wash fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs las vegas raiders 10 p m et on thursday aug 7 nfl network week 2 vs kansas city chiefs 10 p m et on friday aug 15 nfl network week 3 at green bay packers 4 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note seattle begins its season with three of four games against teams that didn t make the 2024 postseason and ends it with four of five versus non playoff squads nfl research what you need to know 1 under center for a new look seahawks offense sam darnold will command a whole lot of attention throughout training camp after three seasons as the seattle starter with a pair of pro bowl campaigns included geno smith was traded to the las vegas raiders in lieu of the seahawks extending him enter darnold who inked a three year 100 5 million deal however darnold has no guaranteed salary after this season and the team can save 27 5 million with a post june 1 2026 cut so with darnold coming off an excellent overall 2024 with the minnesota vikings and two disastrous games to end his campaign the spotlight of scrutiny will be bright even in cloudy washington skies seattle also brought back veteran no 2 drew lock and drafted jalen milroe who possesses eye popping athleticism and the unknown potential of a rookie qb whom fans always clamor to see even in camp darnold s mistakes will be dissected so every snap is important even the ones that don t count toward a final score 2 much of the seahawks offseason was about the notable names they lost geno smith dk metcalf and tyler lockett however seattle made a couple of splashes with the veteran signings of ex dallas cowboys pro bowler demarcus lawrence and former los angeles rams triple crown winner cooper kupp established veteran talent doesn t usually need to show out in training camp but just how realistic it is to hope for career renaissances from kupp and lawrence will be glimpsed in the summer lawrence missed 13 games last season due to a foot injury while kupp s injury woes resulted in 18 games missed over the past three years combined kupp has two games against his former squad to look forward to and lawrence didn t hesitate to offer some shade to his ex club but just how much they have left is likely to be a major factor in the seahawks 2025 fortunes 3 over the 2024 regular season sam darnold threw for career highs of 4 319 yards and 35 touchdowns with the minnesota vikings he averaged 3 08 seconds to throw third longest time in the nfl as he attempted 73 2 of his passes after 2 5 seconds the highest rate in the league according to nfl pro in the vikings playoff loss to the los angeles rams darnold was sacked nine times resulting in his lowest total epa generated last year 27 4 translation for darnold to work within the seahawks offense he needs to be protected well left tackle charles cross is a stalwart and how 2025 first rounder grey zabel comes along at left guard will be crucial at right tackle the biggest question for abraham lucas is staying healthy he s played in just 13 of a potential 34 games over the past two seasons perhaps the largest quandary and camp battle will come at center and right guard olu oluwatimi and jalen sundell will likely duke it out for the starting center spot while christian haynes anthony bradford and possibly sixth rounder bryce cabeldue will decide the right guard slot giving darnold time to work is paramount working out who will be tasked with doing that will be decided in camp

subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

et week 3 vs seattle seahawks saturday aug 23 at 4 p m et nfl network 2025 schedule note the packers will play back to back road games three times in 2025 the most they ve played in one season since matt lafleur s first year as head coach in 2019 excluding international games they went 4 2 in those six games nfl research what you need to know 1 the packers made it clear that jordan morgan will battle incumbent rasheed walker for the left tackle spot during camp the 2024 first round pick didn t play a single snap at tackle during his rookie season he played 185 snaps at guard right and left while missing the final nine games of the regular season due to injury walker has been solid at left tackle particularly in pass protection but has struggled at times in the run game if walker wins the gig morgan could remain a backup unless he shifts inside and beats out sean rhyan for the right guard job whom he couldn t unseat a year ago with elgton jenkins sliding over to center stalwart right tackle zach tom and free agent addition aaron banks at left guard three of the five spots in front of jordan love are spoken for how the other two shake out will largely depend on how morgan performs during camp it could sting if the former first rounder can t find a spot in the starting rotation heading into year 2 2 the packers spoke confidently about their secondary pieces following the release of jaire alexander who swiftly signed in baltimore following an elongated contract standoff keisean nixon sits as the no 1 corner veteran addition nate hobbs could play inside or outside where he slots is one thing to watch during camp carrington valentine took a stride forward in year 2 at a position known for unpredictability from year to year how jeff hafley utilizes his safeties could determine the pecking order at corner opposite xavier mckinney we could see a battle between evan williams and javon bullard bullard could be a movable chess piece who can drop down to play nickel hafley will get his best five dbs on the field each week and who plays more could depend on matchups how the backup crew sorts itself out will be determined during camp 3 what would a packers training camp discussion be without talking about the receiver room the addition of first round pick matthew golden injects playmaking into a group that had a trove of b players but couldn t find consistency or stay healthy in 2024 jayden reed has proven he can win consistently from the slot but is coming off a drop filled season romeo doubs also had a rocky campaign playing just 13 games christian watson hasn t been able to stay healthy but is ahead of schedule in his return from an acl tear if he s able to avoid starting the season on the pup list it would make the packers receiver decision extremely interesting savion williams a third round pick is a wild card to carve out a role green bay also brought in gadget speedster mecole hardman reed and golden should be assured of their spots the rest feels up in the air competition across the board is needed for a crew that disappointed last season and injected two rookies into the fray

atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

replacement for tristan wirfs the all pro left tackle underwent knee surgery on july 8 and is likely to begin the season on the physically unable to perform list which would sideline him at least four games there s no replacing the only player in nfl history who has earned all pro honors at both tackle positions but the silver lining is there s plenty of time to prepare currently on the left tackle depth chart are veteran charlie heck a newcomer and undrafted rookie benjamin chukwuma but perhaps a temporary reshuffling is in order will luke goedeke try his hand at a tackle switch or will left guard ben bredeson another newcomer man the position it s too early to tell now but figuring it out will be a camp priority tampa begins the 2025 season with two road games and hosts the defending super bowl champions in week 4 with wirfs likely out 2 the buccaneers surged toward their fourth consecutive nfc title last season thanks to balanced offense that consistently put up points the unit returns in 2025 largely unchanged barring the availability of wirfs but one other facet of the offense that could be interesting over the next few months is how the depth chart shakes out at wide receiver with mike evans leading the way chris godwin s health and potential return to form is the first item to monitor the bucs are hopeful the veteran wr will be ready for week 1 after a brutal ankle dislocation disrupted a fantastic season in 2024 but the club seems to be prepared either way that s where the head scratching begins tampa selected emeka egbuka with the 19th overall pick and the ohio state product seems poised for the slot role especially with godwin s guidance jalen mcmillan came on strong late last season and is in line for more playing time in year 2 add in veteran sterling shepard trey palmer and seventh rounder tez johnson to the mix and therein lies a good problem to have for the bucs 3 haason reddick was the biggest offseason addition for a buccaneers team that is in need of pressure off the edges defensive tackles vita vea and calijah kancey led the team in sacks in 2024 following a lengthy contract squabble that spilled into the regular season reddick s lone campaign with the jets was one to forget but a new beginning in tampa bay could be what the two time pro bowler needs reddick who previously had four consecutive 10 plus sack seasons before 2024 joins an aggressive todd bowles scheme that will lean on his pass rushing talents and bring him opportunity to cash in on his one year deal there s also a fourth round pick to watch david walker the highest nfl draftee ever from central arkansas had coaches buzzing after rookie minicamp

will put their best foot forward in order to achieve harmony under center penix this season s unquestioned starting qb looks to finely tune his role after showing flashes along his three starts as a rookie entering his second training camp the strong armed lefty now has ample time to establish a rapport with a pass catching corps that remains largely unchanged and to grow into his role as the offense s leading voice over the summer cousins meanwhile appears to have accepted his fate as a backup at this juncture making for what could be a peculiar scene if the high priced qb sees plenty of action in the preseason moreover if cousins 36 looks improved another year removed from a torn achilles could other teams reignite a trade discussion 2 atlanta s mission to improve its pass rush continued with a splashy first round in april s draft selecting jalon walker at no 15 overall before trading back into round 1 to take james pearce 10 picks later walker a product of georgia and last year s butkus award winner was seen as one of top pass rushing prospects but pearce s selection one achieved by trading away next year s first round pick was one of the more surprising developments of the 2025 nfl draft walker and pearce s progression throughout training camp and in the preseason ought to be keenly observed considering the heavy investment the falcons who hired jeff ulbrich as their new defensive coordinator also signed leonard floyd this offseason as part of revamping a pass rush that finished 31st in the league in sacks 31 last season 3 training camp and preseason is where kicking competitions thrive and there s a compelling one brewing in atlanta following younghoe koo s down season the falcons signed german born kicker lenny krieg to a three year deal that includes a signing bonus and a base salary guarantee that kind of contract doesn t come often in the international market but it came after krieg impressed at the international player pathway program s pro day koo who s held the job the past six seasons generated a career low 73 5 field goal percentage and his struggles cost the falcons a game down the stretch with three missed kicks in a three point loss koo and krieg s battle over the next two months could provide the scintillating moments we look for as we prepare for the oncoming season

need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 3 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on thursday sept 24 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 27 why bobby picked the bills fool me once shame on you fool me twice shame on me i will not be picking the chargers for a third straight week nor am i likely to throw my support behind them very much at all in the coming months considering the juggernauts lined up to face them first up on that list the bills who look to be the cream of the afc crop in the early goings of this season josh allen is on fire having already accounted for nine touchdowns five passing four rushing while leading buffalo to 36 or more points in each of the team s first two games while there are some pressing questions about the bills defense nothing has come easy to the chargers in mike mcdaniel s new scheme justin herbert looks uncomfortable his pass catchers have been affected by multiple big drops and injuries and lead back omarion hampton has lost a fumble in both games there s nothing to suggest los angeles can string together enough scoring drives to keep up with buffalo s mighty offense look for the bills to move to 3 0 in dominating fashion why bobby picked the panthers cleveland s upset victory over the buccaneers felt more like tampa bay continuing to be the team that fell on its face throughout the end of last season than a sign the browns will stick it to another nfc south opponent lest that be misconstrued as a browns is the browns take cleveland played well and fought hard for its win deshaun watson was as precise as he s been in years rookie denzel boston looks like a stud and the browns defense was the far more composed side during the game s final two minutes in the aftermath of a 132 minute weather delay the panthers just happen to be playing better ball than both the bucs and the browns bryce young is off to the best start of his career buoyed by the budding wide receiver duo of tetairoa mcmillan and jalen coker he s averaged 324 passing yards through two games with three touchdown passes in each contest it s not out of the question he keeps it going against a cleveland defense still navigating the early days of the post myles garrett era the wild card remains the panthers defensive jekyll and hyde act to start the season are they the closer to the group that gave up 59 points to an explosive bears team in the opener or the unit that dominated a woeful falcons squad while allowing just 3 points even if it s more the former dave canales offense should be able to do enough for a victory why jeremy picked the lions aaron glenn s return to detroit where he was dan campbell s defensive coordinator for four seasons will be the ultimate test for his jets defense s early turnaround after games against the titans and packers offenses asterisk needed gang green s defense which received an influx of veteran talent in the offseason ranks in the top three in yards per game 197 0 first yards per play 4 0 third and third down conversion rate 23 8 second new york will be without a few injured vets in the motor city but should get back joseph ossai for sunday s game whether glenn s jets feast depends on which lions team shows up detroit has a talent advantage on offense but has yet to play a complete game this season nearly blowing week 1 against new orleans forgetting to show up until the second half of the bills loss the lions defense is banged up but so is new york s receiving corps detroit s best bet sunday is getting to geno smith with aidan hutchinson and co the qb hasn t turned the ball over yet but he s faced a 43 4 pressure rate second in the nfl only to the injured jayden daniels and the veteran is due despite his claims otherwise as week 2 proved the jets still need to learn how to win new york is close but the lesson won t come this week against a tested lions team why gennaro picked the texans is this an elimination game in september as the only week 3 matchup between winless teams this afc south showdown screams desperation since 1990 just 2 9 percent of squads that lost their first three games went on to make the playoffs we re talkin five out of 171 people of course last year s texans were one of those five and while houston s hyped defense looked shockingly porous against josh allen s bills in week 1 the unit largely stifled joe burrow and the bengals last sunday i anticipate continued success against a one dimensional colts offense jonathan taylor s a stud no doubt but he has to be a one man army with daniel jones still seemingly working his way back from last december s achilles tear add in the fact that indianapolis 114 million field stretcher just hit injured reserve and houston can commit additional resources to stopping the colts bell cow back meanwhile indy s defense hasn t been able to stop anyone giving up the second most yards ever in the first two weeks of a season 1 2016 raiders 1 035 yards allowed 2 2026 colts 1 029 t 3 1967 falcons 1 025 t 3 2017 saints 1 025 oddly enough the two bookends on that list the 2016 raiders and 2017 saints both made the playoffs with double digit wins maybe the colts have everyone right where they want them or maybe they re doomed to suffer a sixth straight loss to c j stroud and co why dan picked the jaguars there will be no sneaking up on anyone for this season s jaguars and patriots not after they both surprised in 2025 sunday s meeting is an opportunity to establish which squad has more staying power in the afc s upper ranks and the trenches might dictate which team has the edge jacksonville needs better play from the offensive line especially on the interior if it s going to bounce back from blowing a lead against denver new england has a duo that can exploit a team s weakness up the middle with milton williams and christian barmore at defensive tackle one thing that could work in the jags favor is the pats ailing health new england has taken hits to the league s no 1 scoring defense edge rusher dre mont jones and safety craig woodson missed wednesday s practice with shoulder issues and lost rg mike onwenu ankle to injured reserve i m leaning ever so slightly toward the home team in what figures to be a highly entertaining battle why gennaro picked the chiefs two weeks ago we didn t really know what to expect from kansas city the chiefs were coming off their first losing campaign under andy reid while patrick mahomes was returning from knee surgery two games into the season it feels like the team and the quarterback are back whole different story in miami we all knew the 2026 dolphins would be bad that s what happens when a new regime takes the roster down to the studs and carries a whopping 183 7 million in dead money but this feels like a dead team walking what does miami do well without any established firepower beyond rb de von achane the offense can t sustain drives the defense had no answer for raiders rb ashton jeanty in week 1 and nearly allowed a perfect game from 49ers qb brock purdy in week 2 so the better question might be what does miami do this is a rebuilding team without an identity that doesn t play well against a resurgent power with hall of fame leadership yes this is miami s home opener and kansas city s first road game no i don t think that completely flips the script in the fins favor why gennaro picked the titans both teams are coming off a loss but their vibes couldn t be more different tennessee gave philadelphia all it could handle in a 24 20 defeat instilling confidence in the young titans that they can compete with real super bowl contenders a true moral victory new york on the other hand suffered extreme agony in defeat the giants not only lost to the rams by 22 points but they lost jaxson dart to knee surgery john harbaugh had a thousand yard stare after the second year quarterback went down on monday night and now he has to steer the ship without his best defensive player too as brian burns is reportedly set to miss time with an ankle injury remember all that hope following new york s season opening win over dallas consider it dashed the g men just experienced a devastating gut punch and i think the effects carry over into sunday s game against a suddenly frisky foe you know tennessee oc brian daboll would love to knock off the team that fired him last november and while head coach robert saleh failed to exact his revenge on the jets in week 1 he d undoubtedly enjoy notching his first win as titans head coach in his old home of metlife stadium why brooke picked the bengals cincinnati is seeing the fruits of its offseason labor defensively and perhaps no player has been more influential to his new team than dt dexter lawrence through two weeks according to ngs with lawrence on the field the defense has generated a 45 2 pressure rate allowed 2 9 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 58 3 of carries without him on the field cincy has generated a 35 1 pressure rate allowed 5 6 yards per carry and has contacted the ball carrier at or behind the line of scrimmage on 21 4 of carries sexy dexy s influence bodes well for a bengals team heading into a hostile road environment to face an offense in which the qb and play caller don t appear to be on the same page even if pittsburgh gets michael pittman foot back this unit doesn t strike fear in anyone right now and isn t likely to keep up with joe burrow ja 39 marr chase and the bengals oh so explosive offense there s a lot of pressure on the steelers eighth ranked overall and scoring defense to make plays it ll make its fair share but ultimately it won t be enough one nfl pro insight matchup to watch bengals lt orlando brown vs steelers olb alex highsmith brown has allowed a pressure on 13 of his pass blocks against the steelers in 13 career games including the postseason the highest rate he has allowed against any opponent min 100 pass blocks that rate jumps to 15 1 if you limit it to browns time with the bengals six games against pittsburgh meanwhile highsmith has generated 24 pressures against brown including 16 quick pressures under 2 5 seconds the fourth most quick pressures by any pass rusher against a single blocker since 2018 nick herbig has added 13 pressures and three sacks on 78 matchups against brown why dan picked the seahawks just when it seemed like the commanders were starting to cook on offense they are forced once again to face life without jayden daniels who has now had more dislocations of his left elbow than any person should ever have to experience unfortunately for backup qb marcus mariota his return to a starting role coincides with a visit from arguably the league s most ferocious defense the 2026 seahawks are one of just five defenses since 2010 to allow fewer than 20 points and fewer than four yards per play over their first two games of a season per nfl research each of the previous four teams to do so won 11 or more games it s true that seattle might be trotting out its own backup qb for the second week in a row but drew lock has proven a tremendous fill in for sam darnold there s always the threat of a west coast team being discombobulated by a cross country trip but i m not paying it any mind in this case the seahawks are 7 0 in road games that kicked off at 1 p m et under head coach mike macdonald why jeremy picked the 49ers no team is having an easier start to the season than san francisco blowout victories over the jet lagged rams and doe eyed dolphins have the 49ers playing out of this world even when they re on the other side of it in come the cardinals who after a week 1 upset over the potentially fraudulent chargers were who we thought they were against the cream of the nfc west crop in the seahawks the 49ers pose a similar problem to arizona as the hawks did and with brock purdy in the zone the result should be similar expect san francisco to control sunday s game from the jump but just miss out on winning their straight game by at least 20 points thanks to garbage time heroics by trey mcbride and michael wilson why brooke picked the vikings there s early concern around zac robinson s offense in tampa my colleague nick shook s assessment of baker mayfield under his nth oc said it all the veteran qb is uncomfortable in this scheme at this juncture having to right the ship against a blitz happy vikings defense feels like an uphill climb despite mayfield performing well in such situations of late when blitzed this season he has a 68 8 success rate the second highest among qualified qbs per ngs that s a big jump up from his 39 3 mark in 2025 the third lowest if baker can navigate brian flores ferocious front deciphering when the no nonsense dc is sending the house or dropping guys into coverage the bucs should stay competitive i would have argued that tampa has the upper hand if carson wentz were starting but praise jesus we don t have to watch that stuck in the mud quarterback this week with kyler murray set to return we should finally get a better idea of what kevin o connell s offense looks like at close to full strength that ll be especially true if todd bowles defense continues to underperform cleveland s deshaun watson had his best outing in years against the bucs last week and to make matters worse first round edge rusherrueben bain s status is uncertain these teams are trending in opposite directions heading into this nfc clash why bobby picked the saints raiders saints might be the most underrated matchup on the week 3 docket new orleans an overtime two point conversion away from being 2 0 hosts a las vegas squad that remains unbeaten heading into late september the raiders have been playing winning football and doing so without tight end brock bowers who is expected to return from a knee injury sunday but it does come off as more of a mirage than what the saints have been doing while kirk cousins is tied for the nfl lead with six touchdown passes and the defense ranks fifth in points allowed with a league best 45 6 pressure percentage per pro football reference such success has so far come against the rebuilding dolphins and a chargers team in a tailspin even with the loss against the lions new orleans boasts the more impressive resume following its comeback victory over the ravens tyler shough has exhibited an excellent rapport with his top three pass catchers chris olave devaughn vele and juwan johnson he also appears to have the clutch gene after storming back from 21 down to force detroit to overtime and overcoming an 8 point fourth quarter deficit in the win over baltimore if the saints can keep shough comfortable against maxx crosby and co admittedly a big if with left tackle kelvin banks ankle out indefinitely the second year quarterback can be trusted to deliver again in new orleans 2026 home opener why jeremy picked the cowboys how do you say points in portuguese two of the league s most exciting offenses have the potential to produce a classico at the maracana on sunday in only its second international game dallas is looking to export its week 2 bounce back performance over the equator with possession dak prescott s attack proved what it s capable of against washington after their snf snoozer lamar jackson derrick henry and friends will hope to play keep away from dallas as the giants did in week 1 but if zay flowers hamstring misses a second straight game baltimore s aerial attack could be neutered again against a cowboys defense that hasn t found its footing yet under new coordinator christian parker as long as both teams actually have proper footing on the brazilian turf they should tear up and down the field but it ll be dak and dallas with more points in the end if the ravens had trouble with chris olave down the stretch in week 2 just think of the problems they ll encounter covering two olaves in ceedee lamb and george pickens in week 3 why gennaro picked the rams the super bowl lx matchup that wasn t eight months ago the rams and broncos suffered narrow defeats on championship sunday leaving both painfully short of the lombardi trophy game then they opened this season by hitting the road and humiliating themselves on national television both returned to form at home in week 2 though setting up a compelling clash worthy of the sunday night stage showcasing a pair of super bowl winning head coaches and two of the league s most well rounded rosters this game doesn t lack for star power and yet i see its outcome hinging on the rams meat and potatoes kyren williams and blake corum with eerily similar frames games and jersey numbers 23 and 24 l a s two backs are difficult to tell apart and so is their robust ground production through two games williams 23 rushes for 126 yards 5 5 per attempt and a touchdown corum 22 rushes for 133 yards 6 0 per attempt i see los angeles blue collar backfield playing a leading role in this prime time tilt denver cleaned up its tackling last week after an embarrassing display against kansas city s kenneth walker but i still think this front s susceptible to the run free agent departure john franklin myers got 63 million for a reason monday sept 28 why dan picked the eagles questions about the bears quarterback situation linger over what had previously looked like a juicy matchup bathed in prime time allure caleb williams is dealing with the hamstring injury he suffered last week and his backup tyson bagent is in the concussion protocol which means 38 year old third stringer case keenum is in line to start for chicago on monday night if williams and bagent can t go keenum hasn t played in a regular season game since 2023 when he threw one touchdown pass and three interceptions in two starts for the texans it s not hard to envision philadelphia defensive coordinator vic fangio rubbing his hands together in glee at his good fortune potentially missing out on having to game plan against one of the league s most dynamic young qbs and his capable backup the eagles have the lowest point differential 6 of any 2 0 team and struggled to put away the titans who haven t been competitive in years so while they might not be firing on all cylinders it will take an even larger letdown than the team s performance on black friday last year when the bears ran wild over philly to open the door for keenum to pull off the upset it looks like we re about to find out if ben johnson can perform miracles thursday s game why brooke picked the packers the packers lucky to eke out a victory in new york to avoid falling to 0 2 finally return to beloved lambeau field where they have won each of their last 13 home openers i have concerns about jordan love s o line which just lost starting right tackle zach bako bewele for the season and has others banged up og aaron banks ot anthony belton and backup ol donovan jennings love has already taken seven sacks tied for third most faced the fifth highest pressure rate in the nfl this season 42 3 and is tied for the most unblocked pressures faced 12 per nfl pro how matt lafleur game plans for his shorthanded offense against a falcons defense that ranks first against the run ninth on third down and in the red zone and has generated pressure on 41 5 percent on dropbacks seventh in the nfl per next gen stats could tell part of thursday night s story not having cb a j terrell hurts atlanta s chances of slowing christian watson and matthew golden but having michael penix under center should be a boon for that team even if he s still knocking off the rust this should look like a more competent unit one that s better suited to get bijan robinson drake london and kyle pitts more involved these are two flawed teams and though i think we ll see an improved falcons outfit green bay has a much needed home field edge and a defense that s playing with confidence with budding star lukas van ness at the forefront clean up the penalties and this could be a turning point for the pack visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Giants-Rams on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Los Angeles' 28-6 win
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams cruised to their first win of the season in prime time against the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: home sweet home for rams basking in the comfortable confines of sofi stadium the rams returned home from a wayward australian adventure and returned to the form so many thought would be seen matthew stafford looked like the mvp from a season ago davante adams looked like the game tilting wide receiver he was for years and the los angeles defense with aaron donald at the center of it all was sterling as the giants sputtered with jaxson dart lost to a knee injury the rams overcame a couple of turnovers and won handily more than a week removed from falling flat in their opener in the outback against the 49ers the rams handled their business and were impressive stafford rebounding from a zero touchdown week 1 proved that was an aberration with 327 passing yards and four touchdown passes that he did so without an injured puka nacua was all the more impressive adams was simply wonderful in the no 1 wr role hauling in a pair of touchdowns and nearly 200 yards while the two headed running game of kyren williams and blake corum also got the job done 164 combined rushing yards in a game that felt like a blowout despite the rams leading by only two scores throughout most of the night l a racked up 481 yards it wasn t perfect there were turnovers and too many missed opportunities but the rams got right on monday happy to be home feeling looking and playing like themselves monday nightmare for giants seven snaps into the game jaxson dart was savagely sandwiched by the rams pass rush and left grasping his left knee that was it for dart on monday before he was ruled out though dart was joined as being questionable to return by wide receiver malik nabers fortunately nabers returned to play after dinging up his shoulder dart never got back in and andrew thomas groin and brian burns ankle were injured late in the game it was a nightmare of an evening for the giants it was reported dart tried to return to action and general manager joe schoen said he d be ok eschewing long term concerns for the time being meanwhile the giants offense was a struggle bus with jameis winston at the helm the running game went nowhere either cam skattebo was the team s leading rusher with just 36 yards on 12 carries and was curiously replaced by najee harris for two runs inside the 10 yard line late in the first half the biggest takeaway in this one is that the giants offense is absolutely lost without dart and considering his injury history that puts new york in a precarious spot donald makes long awaited return it had been 981 days since aaron donald last played a game a wild card playoff loss against the detroit lions he made a much ado return monday highlighted by stopping najee harris on a third down tackle for loss in the second quarter donald contributed three tackles perhaps more importantly as head coach sean mcvay said after halftime he was energizing the rams defense and los angeles was outstanding jaxson dart and jameis winston were constantly harassed each facing 58 plus pressure rates and new york s running game went nowhere held to 52 yards once upon a time before myles garrett was acquired via trade and donald unretired the rams trading with the chiefs for trent mcduffie was their big offseason splash mcduffie was excellent recording his first interception with his new team and piling up four pass breakups allowing no catches on five targets this was a banner homecoming for donald and a suffocating performance from the d davante s still got it puka nacua was inactive with a hip injury and the rams lack of receiving depth was exposed fortunately davante adams let everyone know he s still got plenty left in the tank piling up eight receptions on 10 targets for 195 yards and two touchdowns the catches and yards were tops for his time with the rams but underscored that the 33 year old can still take over a game if need be and l a needed him second year tight end terrance ferguson shrugged off some bad drops and finished with six catches for 54 yards and a td but his contributions largely came after the game had long been settled beyond that nobody else had more than two catches adams was a force even with stafford dialed in him when adams hauled in an 11 yard fade for six in the third quarter it wasn t just vintage adams but it looked like a called shot an inevitable six points that everyone could see coming and simply couldn t be stopped big blues on both sides on the scoreboard it looked like the giants defense was keeping them in the game more so it was a matthew stafford interception and a kyren williams lost fumble on consecutive offensive plays in the second quarter that did the trick sure the nyg d played its part in those but rams mistakes let the giants hang around in the first half new york mustered just two qb pressures of stafford but somehow only trailed 14 3 with jaxson dart injuring his knee the giants collectively seemed to take a punch to the gut all their wind gone as the game felt like a one sided affair no matter how close the score was l a totaled 481 net yards on 60 plays 8 01 yards per play stafford was pressured on just 15 2 of his dropbacks by game s end a week after a sunday night win over the rival cowboys made the giants the talk of the town they re leaving the west coast battered bruised and beaten in lopsided fashion they ll need to mend up and shore up some issues on both sides of the ball next gen stats insight for giants rams via nfl pro giants rookie right guard francis mauigoa held aaron donald to zero qb pressures on 11 matchups donald had one total qb pressure three tackles and a run stuff on 32 snaps in his first game since the 2023 season nfl research davante adams 11 yard touchdown catch was the 95th of his career including playoffs of 20 yards or fewer which tied antonio gates for second all time only jerry rice 112 has more

news_mentions.headline: Rams QB Matthew Stafford moves into sixth all time in touchdown passes
news_mentions.description: Matthew Stafford’s Hall of Fame résumé continues to build and build. Stafford’s latest accomplishment came on Monday when the Los Angeles Rams quarterback threw three touchdowns to move into sixth place all time in NFL history.
news_mentions.body_text: matthew stafford s resume for hall of fame enshrinement continues to build and build stafford s latest accomplishment came monday when the los angeles rams quarterback threw four touchdowns in a 28 6 win over the new york giants with the third score moving him into sixth place all time in nfl history davante adams caught stafford s 426th career touchdown pass an 11 yarder in the third quarter to propel stafford past philip rivers 425 he had 427 by the end of the evening it s a humbling feeling stafford told espn s lisa salters after the game aside from being a historic night for stafford it was also a massive rebound performance after he went without a touchdown toss in the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers stafford who led the nfl with 46 touchdown passes last season didn t go a game without a td throw in 2025 now he s bounced back from his atypical showing in fine fashion the 38 year old very much resides in rarefied air the reigning ap nfl mvp has fewer touchdowns than only tom brady first 649 touchdown passes drew brees second 571 peyton manning third 539 aaron rodgers fourth 528 and brett favre fifth 508 i have so much respect for the people that played this game before me and am such a big fan of those guys stafford told salters so just to be in that same breath as those guys is a cool feeling for me stafford s first two td passes monday were to adams and kyren williams with the 10 yarder to williams standing as his 143rd with the rams that put him into second all time in rams history moving him ahead of jim everett 142 stafford in six years with the rams now trails only roman gabriel 154 for most td passes in club chronicle he added his fourth touchdown throw of the game and 145th overall for l a late to tight end terrance ferguson if stafford is to catch favre and or become just the sixth nfl player to reach 500 td passes that would mean playing beyond the 2026 campaign for now however stafford has climbed another rung up the all time ladder continuing to defy father time and pen an argument for a spot in canton in the process

news_mentions.headline: Los Angeles Rams training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Grodon provides a refresher on the Los Angeles Rams' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 3: Patrick Mahomes, Dak Prescott, Matthew Stafford heating up
news_mentions.description: Thirty passers are on the move in Nick Shook's QB rankings, with Dak Prescott entering the top five. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 2 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 josh allen can do no wrong following up a four touchdown season debut with a five touchdown showing in week 2 he has an early lead in the mvp race patrick mahomes has proven he s completely back from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is an added bonus next gen stats insight via nfl pro mahomes completed 8 of 9 passes for 133 yards and two tds against man coverage in week 1 a contrast to a 2025 campaign in which his 5 0 yards per attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and 2021 35 the year he was traded to the lions tier 2 the bengals were a bit uneven offensively against houston s top tier defense but they won with big plays made possible by joe burrow s arm talent decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available but jackson s inability to overcome a surprising change in defensive strategy new orleans decreased its blitz rate in the second half and improved and his game sealing interception dealt a blow to his sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards bryce young stacked another excellent showing on top of his season debut making throws that wowed viewers and buoyed his standing in the qb index the confidence and conviction represents a significant step forward for a quarterback who needs a career year ahead of contract talks trevor lawrence was incredibly sharp early in denver fitting passes into tight windows and pushing the jaguars offense forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already propelled two second half comebacks this season and powered the saints to one of the biggest upsets of week 2 it sure helps that chris olave is blossoming a product of a symbiotic relationship between quarterback and receiver next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 10 of his 13 attempts against the blitz for 113 yards a career high mark while also going 17 for 21 for 139 yards and a touchdown when facing four or fewer rushers drew lock lit up arizona in his first start in place of the injured sam darnold throwing without fear and reaping the benefits he steadied the seahawks offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in week 2 against the cardinals the second most of his career along with two touchdowns jalen hurts tossed a couple of interceptions against the titans but he also pushed the eagles to victory with his late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and the broncos still have a problem with starting slowly and nix continues to vacillate between a quarterback who can make incredible throws and commit maddening mistakes next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty of room to grow it was nice to see deshaun watson produce competent play on a sunday it wasn t great by any means nor was it pretty but watson keyed a second half comeback that saw the browns outscore the buccaneers 17 3 to finish the game including a 55 yard catch and run touchdown for rookie denzel boston his second in as many weeks and a third down completion to tight end blake whiteheart for the game winning score that s exponentially better than anything i ve written about watson in about two years which is worthy of a bump next gen stats insight via nfl pro watson is the first starting qb to lead a fourth quarter comeback to snap a 6 game personal losing streak since justin fields 2025 jacoby brissett played better against the seahawks than his stat line suggested in the first half by leaning heavily on trey mcbride for two quarters it appeared as if brissett might go toe to toe with drew lock that optimism faded in a lopsided second half in which brissett couldn t overcome the suffocating seattle defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett was under pressure on 41 9 of dropbacks in week 2 against the seahawks completing 4 of 11 passes for 9 yards with an int under pressure and 13 of 17 for 86 yards and a td from a clean pocket we have real reason to be concerned about tampa bay s offense a scheme in which baker mayfield simply appears uncomfortable and uncertain i m not sure there s a quick fix to this issue either a frantic skittish mayfield isn t going to be capable of overcoming an offense that lacks identity rhythm and confidence tier 7 malik willis is trying his best to lead an offense that simply doesn t take care of the details and carries one of the lowest ceilings in the nfl it s not necessarily his fault but it s clear he s not quite the quarterback who can carry an undermanned team to victory at this stage in his career aaron rodgers age was painfully obvious in new england on sunday his offensive line struggled to protect him his receivers didn t help him and he didn t look like he enjoyed his job very much somehow an offense with more freedom to be aggressive has produced worse results and at 42 years old it looks like rodgers isn t capable of overcoming these challenges right now next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers finished with 187 passing yards 0 touchdowns and 1 int his fifth straight start with one passing td or fewer tied for the second longest such streak of his career carson wentz s performance was entirely forgettable in a rainy 9 3 victory in chicago we ll see if kyler murray s return can get the offense back on track cooper rush has been the worst quarterback in the nfl through two weeks but thankfully michael penix is returning to the lineup this week we ll see if his style of play fits better than that of rush who wasn t helped much by an underperforming offensive line
